data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Papagena was a mythical figure representing the divine gift of a mother to her child. This name is derived from the Greek word 'papa' meaning 'god' and 'genea' meaning 'birth' or 'offspring'. The name Papagena carries the meaning “God's gift” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Papagena usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.
